::: {.lead-text}
I am an economist working on applied econometrics and economic policy. My research focuses on high-dimensional methods and causal inference, and on how rigorous quantitative evidence can inform macroeconomic and regional development. I hold an M.Sc. in Economics from the University of Bonn.
:::
